  QualifiedPackage upstream.interfaces
  public interface Values<A, B>
    fun total
    public open val first: A <computed>
    public open var second: B <computed>
  public class Remote<A, B>(val a: A, var b: B), Values<A, B>
    public open override val first: A <computed>
      get()
        FieldAccess a
          This
    public open override var second: B <computed>
      get()
        FieldAccess b
          This
      set(value)
        assign .b
          This
          Var value
